commentsEmptyBody: Start the thread. Type @ to mention a teammate who can open this record.
commentsErrorBody: Comments could not be loaded. The record itself is unaffected.
commentsDeniedTitle: You cannot read comments on this record
commentsDeniedBody: Comments follow the record's access. Ask a workspace admin for access.
composerPlaceholder: Write a comment. Type @ to mention someone.
mentionNobody: No one who can read this record matches
mentionHint: Only people who can open this record are listed.
mentionRejected: {names} cannot open this record, so they were not mentioned. Remove the mention or share the record first.
mentionTooMany: Mention at most {max} people in one comment.
composerDisabledNoPerm: You need the comments.write permission to comment.
lockNotAuthor: Only the author or a moderator can change this comment.
lockWindowClosed: Authors can edit or delete a comment for 15 minutes after posting.
notFound: That comment or record no longer exists.
denied: You do not have permission to do that.
error: Something went wrong. Nothing was changed.
followed: You will be notified about this record
followDemo: Demo workspace: follow state is not saved.
followersNote: Followers are notified of new comments and rule matches on this record.
feedEmptyBody: Changes, comments and assignments on this record appear here.
feedWorkspaceSub: Only records you can open appear here.
notifSub: Mentions, assignments and rule alerts for this workspace.
notifEmptyBody: New mentions and alerts show up here and on the bell.
notifPartialEmail: Email delivery is not connected yet. Email alerts are queued, not sent.
notifDeniedTitle: Sign in to a workspace to see notifications
prefsSub: Choose how you hear about changes. Email is queued only; sending is not connected yet.
prefsMutedNote: Muted events create no notifications for you at all.
quietBody: Email alerts wait until quiet hours end. In-app notifications still arrive silently.
quietInvalid: Pick two different times, for example 22:00 and 07:00.
rulesSub: Who is told when something happens in this workspace. In-app is always on.
rulesDeniedBody: You can still set your own preferences above.
rulesEmptyBody: Add a rule to tell owners, managers or followers when a record changes.
ruleEventInvalid: Use an event type such as lead.assigned or lead.*
rulesDemoNotice: Demo workspace: rules are shown but not saved.
prefsDemoNotice: Demo workspace: settings are not saved.
